snippet.title: Just Arrived - 80's Slasher Game Teaser!
snippet.description:
Adquira já sua cópia: https://616games.itch.io/just-arrived

616 GAMES PRESENTS... 

(JUST ARRIVED - 2021) The game takes place in 1985 in a building located on the outskirts of New York. Thomas is just an ordinary resident of the place, terrified that there is a killer on the loose he can't sleep.
The murderer is being wanted by the police for a few months, known as "Hammer Maniac" because he crushes the head and limbs of his exerted using a common hammer.
You will have to investigate the locals, who is the killer? ...he may be closer than you think.


ABOUT GAMEPLAY:
- Choose camera style: PSX,VHS,DIstorted or 1995.
- A game with ps1 graphics inspired by the cult horror of the 80s.
- Investigative, dialogues, interactions...
- First person camera
- The game contains only one ending.
